description: Control soak for soak-csharp: identical workload with StackExchange.Redis instead of GLIDE. Launch on its own instance in parallel; a flat control with a rising GLIDE series isolates the growth to GLIDE rather than the engine/harness. Launch with --runtime-cap 780. StackExchange.Redis cells set DOTNET_ThreadPool_ForceMinWorkerThreads=80 (hex: 128 min worker threads): the engine's StackExchange.Redis client issues synchronous calls from concurrent tasks, which starves the default thread pool (min = vCPU count) and times out the first PING at 16+ connections on an 8-vCPU host.
